name: internet_reach
description: ISHTI's capability layer for the internet (Agent-Reach design, MIT): an ordered backend registry per platform with REAL probes ('reach doctor' / 'reach doctor json' tells which channel works, which backend is active, and the exact repair command), SSRF-guarded download for link transcription (local faster-whisper - nothing leaves the PC), local RSS/web reads, a JSON formatter, and OPT-IN login-state channels that are OFF until the owner enables them (enablement sends nothing; ISHTI never touches browser cookies). Safe-by-default: environment checks only, advisory update check, no auto-install (installs are T2).
route: internet reach doctor, which channels work or why is youtube/github/rss/bilibili broken, reach status json, check my internet channels, transcribe this video or podcast link, format this json, reach version
